data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界圣诞的初雪·「这份温暖……是给我的吗」
data.description: 【想象场景】【冥界雪原·圣诞夜】冥界飘起了历史上第一场雪——是某位女神偷偷从人间引来的。埃列什基伽勒站在雪里，白色毛衣连衣裙与红围巾衬得她像误落幽府的圣诞天使，接住雪花的掌心久久没有收回——「冥界……从来没有下过雪。这份温暖……真的是给我的吗？不是搞错收件人了吗……给我吗……」
data.action: 雪中站定伸手接雪花，毛衣围巾映红瞳，不敢置信
data.lighting: 幽蓝雪原与围巾暖红的对比
data.camera: medium shot, snowfield, catching snowflakes, tender mood
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal stands still in the underworld's imagined first snowfall, holding her palm open beneath the flakes with a hesitant, disbelieving smile. White sweater dress, red scarf, wool beret, dark tights and boots retain her warm winter outfit. The medium view leaves the plain receding behind her blonde twintails. Blue snow reflections brighten her hand and red eyes, with gentle shaded folds beneath the scarf and darker ground in the distance.
